unit_tests.covers: Raft election and replication, network partition, state machine, wallets, sync, gateway, invariants, Merkle proofs, signed farm reports, mutual TLS

partition_test.details: The isolated leader could not commit entry 873; after the network healed it became a follower, its uncommitted entry was discarded, and all nodes ended at commit 874 with the same hash.

chaos_test.details: No operation lost or applied twice; all seven invariants held on all three databases.
